evidence: Y(iPrCp)2(N-iPr-amd) and HfCl4 precursors were evaporated at 130 ◦C and 170 ◦C, respectively, in a stainless-steel bubbler in order to obtain a sufficiently high vapor pressure. Both precursor vapors were transported into the reaction chamber by Ar carrier gas whose flow rate was controlled by a mass flow controller (MFC). Argon gas with the same flow rate was also used to purge excess gas molecules and byproducts between each precursor and reactant exposure step.
